verdict.rationale: BILL Spend & Expense uses AI features such as AI-powered categorization and the Invoice Coding Agent, so asking whether customers can opt out of AI training on their data is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an AI-training opt-out, a data-use policy, or a no-training commitment. The pack covers APIs, webhooks, payments and the docs MCP server, none of which address training-data use.
